title: TemporalLightModulationAndFlickerMeasurementSchemaV2
description: Comprehensive optoelectronic instrumentation and signal processing specification for warehouse temporal light modulation (flicker) measurement, establishing practical reconstruction sampling margins and separating illuminance from temporal modulation.

epistemic_classification.scientific_qualification: Neither 350 lux nor flicker_index <= 0.05 / f_mod >= 1000 Hz represents a universal physical safety law. They are project-specific engineering acceptance targets chosen to mitigate CMOS rolling-shutter banding and low-light noise.

illuminance_acceptance.metric: Spatial mean illuminance across corridor ground plane and camera optical axes
illuminance_acceptance.instrument_class: Class B DIN 5032-7 Cosine-Corrected Lux Meter (e.g. Testo 540 / Gossen Mavolux 5032B)
illuminance_acceptance.acceptance_rule: 300.0 lux <= mean_illuminance <= 400.0 lux across all 5 test positions

temporal_light_modulation_acceptance.quantity: Temporal Light Modulation / High-Frequency Optical Flicker
temporal_light_modulation_acceptance.metric: Flicker Index (FI) and Fundamental Modulation Frequency (f_mod)

instrument_requirements.sensor_type: Amplified Silicon Photodetector (e.g. Thorlabs PDA36A2 or equivalent)
instrument_requirements.digitizer_type: Digital Storage Oscilloscope (Keysight DSOX1204G / Tektronix TBS2000B)
instrument_requirements.anti_alias_filter: Hardware 4th-order anti-alias low-pass Butterworth filter (f_cutoff = 50.0 kHz)
instrument_requirements.sampling_margin_rationale: Nyquist criterion (2 * f_max = 100 kSa/s) is insufficient for pulse-shape and harmonic reconstruction. A sampling rate of >= 1.0 MSa/s provides 20x oversampling of the 50 kHz analog bandwidth, ensuring accurate waveform peak/trough extraction.
instrument_requirements.waveform_preprocessing: DC offset baseline subtraction, high-frequency noise de-glitching via median filter (window = 5 samples), and integer-period truncation over continuous 2.0 s capture.

flicker_index_definition.mathematical_formula: Flicker_Index = Area_Above_Mean / (Area_Above_Mean + Area_Below_Mean) over an integral number of periods

temporal_light_modulation_acceptance.rolling_shutter_banding_qualification: A modulation frequency f_mod >= 1000 Hz does NOT by itself guarantee zero rolling-shutter artifacts. If camera exposure time t_exp is short (e.g. <= 1/1000 s) or line readout time t_row (~25 us) aliases with duty cycle harmonics, spatial banding may still occur. Full immunity requires camera shutter synchronization or high DC-current ballast drivers.
temporal_light_modulation_acceptance.status_explanation: Physical photodiode and DSO hardware are not yet connected to warehouse lighting. Gate C7 cannot pass until physical optical oscillogram is recorded and analyzed.

gate_c7_acceptance_rule.rule: Gate C7 PASS requires BOTH Illuminance Acceptance == PASS AND Temporal Light Modulation Acceptance == PASS. If either is unverified or fails, Gate C7 remains UNVERIFIED_PENDING_PHYSICAL_COMMISSIONING.
